questions.text: How long have you noticed this lump or mass, and has it changed in size since you first found it?
questions.purpose: Characterise onset and growth trajectory of the mass

questions.text: Is the mass hard or firm to touch, and does it feel fixed (immovable) rather than freely mobile?
questions.purpose: Identify features of malignancy: hardness and fixity suggest invasive disease

questions.text: Have you noticed any associated skin changes over the mass, such as redness, dimpling, ulceration, or peau d'orange appearance?
questions.purpose: Detect cutaneous signs of malignant infiltration

questions.text: Have you experienced unintentional weight loss of more than 5% of your body weight over the past 3 months?
questions.purpose: Identify constitutional B-symptom suggesting systemic malignancy

questions.text: Do you have any enlarged lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin alongside this mass?
questions.purpose: Assess for regional lymphadenopathy indicating possible metastatic spread

questions.text: Is the mass painful or tender?
questions.purpose: Pain can indicate rapid growth, inflammation, or nerve involvement

questions.text: Do you have a personal or family history of cancer?
questions.purpose: Family history raises prior probability of malignancy and may guide pathway

questions.text: Are you currently experiencing night sweats or fevers that occur without an obvious infection?
questions.purpose: Night sweats and fever are B-symptoms associated with lymphoma and other haematological malignancies
